display_long_description:
ForgeX: The Ultimate VR Welding Simulator

ForgeX offers a groundbreaking welding simulation experience, allowing users to master the art of welding using four major types of welding processes: MIG, Flux-Core, Stick, and TIG. Designed for both beginners and professionals, ForgeX provides a highly realistic, risk-free environment to build muscle memory, perfect technique, and prepare for real-world trade challenges.

Key Features:
- Complete Position Mastery: Practice across all essential welding positions—1G (Flat), 2G (Horizontal), 3G (Vertical), and 4G (Overhead)—to develop comprehensive, industry-ready skills.
- Extensive Plate Catalog: Access a rich selection of standard joint types and environments, with an expanded catalog of specialized, optional practice plates to simulate virtually any scenario.
- In-Depth Performance Analytics: Receive instant, detailed post-weld feedback analyzing your speed, travel angles, arc distance, and accuracy to accelerate skill development.
- Safe & Cost-Effective Training: Ideal for trade schools, educational institutions, professional welders, and hobbyists looking to refine their craft without material waste or safety hazards.

Step into the virtual booth, explore diverse setups and positions, and refine your technique with precision feedback in ForgeX VR.
